author: reek
body: A partitioned disk with NO fact-store partition on it. The store has nowhere of its own to address, so it refuses.

author: reek
body: This test is unchanged by the partition work and that is the point of keeping it. The store now addresses relative to a partition of its own type; a disk that carries a partition table and does not carry such a partition is still refused, and refusing it is still the only safe answer.

author: reek
body: Any one alone would pass for a store that refused everything or for one that refused nothing. The last is the one that separates "safe" from "useful", which is the direction a guard quietly slides in.
